Walking parent[] from t gives you the path backwards. Collect it into a temporary array, then copy it into path[] in reverse.
Use parent[s] = -1 as the terminator, and stop the walk when x becomes -1. The loop 'for (int x = t; x != -1; x = parent[x])' does the whole traversal.
